description: Returns the writing kit for a new Plot Speaks story as one text: a short introduction to how a story is built (a public story.md plus a private answer key, secrets.md, reviewed by a person before anything is published), a suggested way for the writer and assistant to draft, review and submit it together, and the format template for the chosen genre and length. Reads only; nothing is stored or recorded beyond anonymous counts of genre and length. Genre and length are fixed choices, and omitting either gives the default.

genre.description: Kind of story to write: murder-mystery (default), dark (a dark murder mystery), adventure, branching (a choose-your-path story), trivia (a trivia board) or game (a voice game); chooses which template is returned

length.description: Playing time of the story: "20" or "30" minutes in one chapter (default "30"), or "2-chapter" for a story in two sittings

name: write_story
title: Write a story
